تستذنبوا (form X)
# تَسْتَذْنِبُوا (tastaḏnibū) /tas.tað.ni.buː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَذْنَبَ (istaḏnaba)
# تُسْتَذْنَبُوا (tustaḏnabū) /tus.tað.na.buː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَذْنَبَ (istaḏnaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
